name: FrameLine
tagline: Screenshots, screen recordings, annotation and OCR from your menu bar, 100% local.
description: FrameLine captures an area, a window or the whole screen, and records your screen with system audio and microphone. Annotate a shot, pin it on screen, copy its text (OCR), trim a recording, and find everything again in the history. 100% local, interface in 10 languages.
